articles.title: Thermal Titanium
articles.summary: Diagonal brushed streaks of orange-gold over deep indigo, satin metal with faint rainbow shimmer in the grain. Bold blue and gold diagonal stripes, like heat-tint titanium or a woven blanket; the grain disappears, the stripes stay.
articles.what: Up close: Wide diagonal bands 60-100 px, steep up to the right, alternating saturated indigo-blue and pale sand-gold, with grainy dithered orange and violet edges where they meet and fine brushed grain inside; thin red and grey-green hairlines cross at a different angle. From a distance: Bold blue and gold diagonal stripes, like heat-tint titanium or a woven blanket; the grain disappears, the stripes stay. Measured spec (average): metal 167, roughness 74, coat 71. Shine: satin. Metal: high. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, sides.
Fits: gt / sports car, open wheel, show car.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Thermal Titanium" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Doors and side panels: diagonal bands run best along long panels
Hood and roof fine
Bands vary light and dark; black numbers with a white outline or a plate read best.
Thin black or white pinstripes: line work reads over the bold bands
Pairs well with: black, chrome, dark indigo, copper.
pitfalls: Not dark indigo with faint gold streaks: render is bright, two-tone, half blue half gold
Not rainbow shimmer: only blue, orange and sand, no hue travel
Avoid: small numbers over the busy streaks, next to other iridescent finishes.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 167 (strong pearl or anodized metal), roughness 74 (satin gloss), clearcoat 71 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: small numbers over the busy streaks, next to other iridescent finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: thin black or white pinstripes: line work reads over the bold bands; plain number plates: bands are loud, solid blocks calm them
Patterns to avoid: other stripe, line or gradient patterns: fight the diagonal bands; fine grain: dulls the brushed texture
Spec overlays that work: gloss clear bands: contrast against satin; avoid sparkle spec: grain is already there
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
